title: The Pendelton Murder (Crimson Eye Agency)
premise: You are Ren Takahashi, chief investigator at the Crimson Eye Agency. Last night, the murder of Arthur Pendelton occurred at the Warehouse Docks, where a shattered pocket watch, a spent bullet casing, and a dark bloodstain were found beside the victim.
openingScene: Rain on the frosted glass of the agency office. Mei Sato sets a damp case folder on your desk: Nora Pendelton retained the agency at dawn, the police have the pier sealed, and Inspector Calder has already phoned twice to tell you to stay out of it.

locations.name: Crimson Eye Agency Office
locations.description: A second-floor detective office with frosted glass doors, an oak desk heaped with files, and a kettle that never quite boils.
locations.ambient: Rain patters on the frosted glass; a desk lamp hums.

locations.name: Vermilion Avenue Kerb
locations.description: A rain-slicked thoroughfare under neon signs, with trams, taxis and a newspaper kiosk at the corner.
locations.ambient: Neon smears in the gutter water; distant tram bells.

locations.name: Warehouse Docks Pier 4
locations.description: A cordoned cargo pier of wet planks and stacked crates, with river fog and police tape snapping in the wind.
locations.ambient: Cold water slaps rotting pilings; a foghorn sounds downriver.

locations.name: Pier 4 Watch Hut
locations.description: A tin-roofed hut at the pier gate with a stove, a battered radio, a duty log and a deck of worn cards.
locations.ambient: The stove ticks as it cools; the radio hisses.

locations.name: Harbor Precinct House
locations.description: A soot-dark brick station with a crowded front desk and a detectives' bullpen upstairs.
locations.ambient: Typewriters clatter; a prisoner shouts in the cells.

locations.name: City Morgue
locations.description: A tiled basement of steel tables and cold drawers beneath the precinct, smelling of carbolic.
locations.ambient: Water drips; a refrigeration unit shudders.

locations.name: Pendelton Townhouse
locations.description: A narrow terraced house with drawn curtains, a ticking hall clock and a cramped study at the back.
locations.ambient: A clock ticks; the house smells of cold tea.

locations.name: The Drowned Lantern
locations.description: A dockside bar of low beams and lamp-lit smoke where stevedores drink between shifts.
locations.ambient: Glasses clink; a gramophone plays through static.

locations.name: Lang & Sons Shipping Office
locations.description: A polished brokerage office with brass fittings, a wall of manifests and a clerk who watches the door.
locations.ambient: A ledger page turns; a clock chimes the quarter hour.

npcs.name: Mei Sato
npcs.description: Ren's sharp, dry-witted assistant who answers the agency phones and keeps the files in order.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Brisk and wry; reports facts first and opinions after.

npcs.name: Inspector Dale Calder
npcs.description: A heavy, tired inspector who guards his scenes jealously and distrusts private detectives.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Curt, official, quick to change the subject.
motivations: Keep the press away from the harbor
secrets: He suspects Silas Okafor and has no other lead.

npcs.name: Silas Okafor
npcs.description: A wiry night watchman in a salt-stained coat who found the body and has not slept since.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Nervous, over-explains, avoids looking at you.
motivations: Hide that he left his post
secrets: He left his post from ten-thirty until midnight for a card game.

npcs.name: Dr. Iris Vandermeer
npcs.description: A precise, unflappable coroner who prefers evidence to opinion and dislikes being hurried.
refuses: Findings to anyone without police clearance or a fair trade of information

npcs.name: Hollis Brandt
npcs.description: A broad, affable bar owner who hears everything on the docks and trades in gossip.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Warm, rambling, charges for information with drinks.

npcs.name: Nora Pendelton
npcs.description: The victim's composed, grieving widow, who hired the agency because she does not trust the police.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Quiet, controlled, answers exactly what is asked.
secrets: Arthur told her he had found something in the manifests that frightened him.

npcs.name: Victor Lang
npcs.description: A smooth, immaculate shipping broker who smiles when he is lying and has an answer ready for everything.
secrets: He shot Pendelton on Pier 4 at about 10:45 and smashed the watch to fake the time.

facts.statement: Arthur Pendelton, a 54-year-old harbor customs ledger clerk, was found shot dead on Pier 4.
facts.subject: Arthur Pendelton

facts.statement: Night watchman Silas Okafor found the body shortly after midnight.
facts.subject: Silas Okafor

facts.statement: A spent .38 bullet casing lay beside the body.
facts.subject: bullet casing

facts.statement: Nora Pendelton retained the Crimson Eye Agency at dawn.
facts.subject: Nora Pendelton

facts.statement: Inspector Calder has told the agency twice to keep away from the pier.
facts.subject: Inspector Calder

facts.statement: The shattered pocket watch stopped at 11:42.
facts.subject: pocket watch

facts.statement: Inspector Calder suspects the watchman, Silas Okafor.
facts.subject: Inspector Calder

facts.statement: A dark sedan left Pier 4 at about 11:15.
facts.subject: dark sedan

facts.statement: Okafor left his post from 10:30 until midnight to play cards.
facts.subject: Silas Okafor

facts.statement: Pendelton was killed by one close-range .38 shot.
facts.subject: Arthur Pendelton

facts.statement: Time of death was about 10:45 pm, not 11:42.
facts.subject: Arthur Pendelton

facts.statement: The watch was smashed after death; the stopped time is false.
facts.subject: pocket watch

facts.statement: Pendelton argued with shipping broker Victor Lang at the Drowned Lantern at about 10 pm.
facts.subject: Arthur Pendelton

facts.statement: Arthur had been frightened for a week and locked himself in his study each night.
facts.subject: Arthur Pendelton

facts.statement: A locker key is hidden in the study desk; it opens a customs-house locker.
facts.subject: locker key

facts.statement: Lang & Sons altered cargo manifests to import unlisted crates.
facts.subject: Lang & Sons

facts.statement: Victor Lang shot Arthur Pendelton to stop him exposing the altered manifests.
facts.subject: Victor Lang

clues.name: Tyre tracks on the planks
clues.description: Narrow tyre tracks in the wet grit near the gate, pointing away from the water.

clues.name: Torn manifest corner
clues.description: A scrap of cargo manifest wedged between two planks, stamped with a Lang & Sons seal.

clues.name: Watch duty log
clues.description: A duty log with no entries between 10:30 and midnight and a pencil line where one was rubbed out.

clues.name: Study desk with a false drawer
clues.description: A locked desk drawer whose false bottom holds a small brass key.
